command:
set -e; export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk"; export ANDROID_HOME="$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT"; printf 'sdkmanager=%s
' "$(command -v sdkmanager)"; printf 'avdmanager=%s
' "$(command -v avdmanager)"; printf 'emulator=%s
' "$(find "$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT" /opt/homebrew -path '*/emulator' -type f 2>/dev/null | head -5 | tr '
' ' ')"; sdkmanager --sdk_root="$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT" --list_installed | sed -n '1,120p'
